case.name: Taiyaki Girl NPC
case.description: Taiyaki Girl is an anime girl in a giant fish costume resembling the Japanese fish-shaped cake, Taiyaki, a sweet street food snack. Your character may find this noteworthy in and of itself.

case.name: Removed Taiyaki Suit
case.description: Taiyaki Girl has just removed her Taiyaki suit, leaving her in nothing but her underwear. This is the first time her body is seen during the game.
